prompt: At the time of their publication, who was the editor of the magazine that published the two short stories that first developed the World Urslula LeGuinn would use for the first of the two books Harold Bloom would later call her masterpieces?
answer: The editor was **Cele Goldsmith**, editor of *Fantastic* magazine when Ursula K. Le Guin’s Earthsea stories **“The Word of Unbinding”** (January 1964) and **“The Rule of Names”** (April 1964) were published. These stories introduced the world later developed in *A Wizard of Earthsea*, the first of the two works Harold Bloom called Le Guin’s masterpieces.
